U.note: Compact, coherent bento nav that unfolds from a pill bar with staggered tiles, working roast cycling, quantity, newsletter validation and keyboard arrows, but the content is thin and the tile text is small.

V.note: Rich, well-made bento drawer with working roast chips, price math, subscription toggle, cafes, accordion and toasts plus dark mode, though it reads more like a shop panel than a menu and the logo text vanishes on mobile.

W.note: Distinctive condensed-type brand with a popover bento that scales out of the handle and a persistent state summary, but the open panel covers the hero text and the hero copy spacing is slightly off.

X.note: A functional drink-ordering bento with working cart math, but the size chips on the dark hero tile are cream-on-cream and nearly unreadable and it drifts toward an order app.

Y.note: Most polished: a cohesive oat-colored box with varied tile sizes, expandable sub-tiles, badge feedback, status line, inert handling and a good mobile layout.

Z.note: Inventive tin-stack unfold animation with a real nav grid, but tiles are small and tilted with tiny text, the menu is mostly navigation links with little depth, and the opened panel is cramped.
